verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own model download path: `scripts/fetch_models.py --tier edge0-35b` fetches bundled "repos" that are ready to run in one download, and models can be run locally via `edge0 serve`, a one-shot chat, or `AutoEngine.from_pretrained`. However, the evidence never names Hugging Face as the source. Support also appears limited to curated Edge0 tiers, auto-detected from `config.json`, rather than arbitrary open models. Missing for 10: explicit Hugging Face Hub download/integration, running arbitrary open models beyond the predefined tiers, and independent hands-on corroboration.
